notes.title: Winter Update is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26698856/a495f620a13c28a207bfbc156838e11d76840e48.png[/img]
Greetings!
The Winter Update is here.

What's New!?
- 4 new themes
- Snow Effect
- Joyful Holidays Music

As not everyone celebrates Christmas or actually wants to play in a festive environment these features must be manually activated.

In order to activate them you have to press these keys on your keyboard:

F1 - Activate Snow
F2 - Deactivate Snow
F3 - Play the Winter Update song
F4 - Play a random song
[i]However, please, do note that activating Snow might cauuse performance issues on lower-end computers as the effect is done via particles. Thank you for understanding![/i]

Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

notes.title: Be spooked!
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!

Since Halloween is just around the corner i've updated the game a bit.

- Added an animated Halloween theme
- Fixed a somewhat rare issue that occured on laptops
- Improved performance
- If you haven't used shuffle during your playthrough, you can now use it when you run out of moves

Trading cards are ready, but have yet to be approved!
